<thought>The spectrum shows a main peak at ~199 with a nearly equal intensity peak at ~201 (M+2), characteristic of bromine’s two isotopes (79Br and 81Br) which appear in roughly 1:1 ratio. No other element shows a comparable distinctive isotopic pattern, so bromine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
